title: Daniel Anderson: IT Support Specialist
description: With the help of #GrowWithGoogle's IT Support Professional Certificate, Daniel Anderson grew his love for technology into a career helping other people. To launch your career in IT support, visit: https://g.co/itcert

asr.full_text: Nebraska. It's a beautiful state. It's not only a beautiful state, it's a beautiful state of mind. My fiance got her first teaching job here in Grand Island, Nebraska, and I made the choice. To drop out of college and move to Grand Island. When I first got here, I found that I couldn't. Get work. Without a college degree, most people in this area are going to struggle. Eventually,. I found a job at Central Community College as a night shift security officer. I felt like I was just fighting an uphill battle, like I wouldn't be able to gain any. Traction in my career. I've worked with computers my entire life. That is what I love. I have a friend currently going through an IT program and he said, hey, you should search. For Google's IT support program. Seeing that, I thought this is something that I can do. I probably would average 10 to 12 hours a week. I finished the program in five months. I was almost in tears when I got done with the course. Soon after that, I got an email for a job opening. On Central Community College's IT team. When we were viewing Daniel, what shined in his resume. Was his Google credentials he brought with him. It really did stand out against the majority. Of our other candidates. I love my new job. I think one of the most validating things in the world. Is recognizing that you've helped someone. It's wild that I can claim that I'm doing what I love,. But I also have more time to spend with the people I love.

annotation.contextual_rationale: This video is non-scam content because it is a career testimonial about overcoming employment difficulties, completing IT support training, and working in information technology. Its promotional element is an invitation to learn about Google's IT Support Professional Certificate, presented in an ordinary educational and workplace context rather than as an offer of financial returns.
annotation.fine_grained_rationale: The content centers on an IT support education program and the speaker's account of completing it and working in IT, which fits education and technology content. The description also promotes the certificate, but the supplied evidence does not describe a financial-return mechanism.
